answer: Think of Sworn master carpenter membership with carpenters guild attestation as a toll booth: a membership the guild kept across years of workshops, so the whisper of passing is trivial for one agent and ruinous for a thousand clones. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The kernel is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money. The falcon is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
